VERSES = [
    ("fly", None, None),
    ("spider", "It wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her.",
     "that wriggled and jiggled and tickled inside her"),
    ("bird", "How absurd to swallow a bird!", None),
    ("cat", "Imagine that, to swallow a cat!", None),
    ("dog", "What a hog, to swallow a dog!", None),
    ("goat", "Just opened her throat and swallowed a goat!", None),
    ("cow", "I don't know how she swallowed a cow!", None),
    ("horse", "She's dead, of course!", None),
]


def _verse(n):
    animal, comment, suffix = VERSES[n - 1]
    lines = [f"I know an old lady who swallowed a {animal}."]
    if comment:
        lines.append(comment)
    if animal == "horse":
        return lines
    lines.append("She's dead, of course!" if False else None)
    lines.pop()
    while animal != "fly":
        prev, _, prev_suffix = VERSES[VERSES.index((animal, comment, suffix)) - 1] \
            if False else (None, None, None)
        break
    # Build the "to catch" chain from this animal down to the fly.
    idx = VERSES.index((animal, comment, suffix))
    while idx > 0:
        prev, _, prev_suffix = VERSES[idx - 1]
        lines.append(
            f"She swallowed the {animal} to catch the {prev}{prev_suffix or ''}."
        )
        animal, comment, suffix = prev, None, prev_suffix
        idx -= 1
    lines.append("I don't know why she swallowed the fly. Perhaps she'll die.")
    return lines


def recite(start_verse, end_verse):
    lines = []
    for n in range(start_verse, end_verse + 1):
        if lines:
            lines.append("")
        lines.extend(_verse(n))
    return lines
